sentences: There was a strange sensation in my mouth.
I do not want to complicate the rules of our game.
It can frustrate me when answers are not direct.

We moved to a new house this month. Our family is bigger now, so we needed more room. There was so much to do that it could overwhelm us, but Dad made it easy. He made a slow, deliberate list of every job. We carried the furniture out box by box, and I put a name on each one. Contrary to my worry, moving day was such fun. My best friend even came to help us. I cannot wait to sort out my new room!

A famous architect came to speak at our school. She showed us her sophisticated plan for a new school building. In her design, a clean line marks where the old wing meets the new. Her expertise and courage made a deep mark on me. My ambition grew as I listened to her wonderful ideas. One day, I hope to design a great building too.
The teacher will dictate the sentences for the pupils to write.
One large apple is equivalent to two small ones in my bowl.
The park rules prohibit dogs from swimming in the duck pond.

The family next door had an emergency last week. Their little cat was in distress inside a small hole! My dad reached down alongside the wall to free it. We all laughed with joy once it was safe. To thank us, the family gave us a big cake. Later, they built a safe enclosure in their garden so it cannot get stuck again. The little cat is now friends with our cat too. Both of them are sweet and never aggressive. A happy evening closed our perfect day.

We spent a wonderful day at the town fair. First, Mum found a real bargain at a toy shop. A friendly merchant sold us a toy train. Next, we paid for admission to a fun steam train ride. We climbed into an old red carriage at the front. As a passenger, I watched the conductor drive the train. It slowed at a junction where two tracks met, then took the left one. Later, we used the receipts for the train admission to claim complimentary snacks. By the end, we had walked more than one kilometre around the fair. We all felt a deep satisfaction, and we cannot wait to visit again.
I look through the toy catalogue to choose my birthday gift this year.
I put the letter for my grandma inside a big white envelope.
The police had a suspicion that someone had entered the house.

A doctor came to our school and gave us a comprehensive talk about staying healthy. She told us that a cigarette is harmful and can hurt our body. She also said that too much sugar can inhibit our energy and make us feel tired. Healthy food is important, and sweets should not substitute for a proper meal. We should also limit how much sugary snacks we eat each day. Good food and enough sleep are more valuable than any treat. At the end of the talk, we made a resolution to eat well, sleep well and take care of our bodies. I will embrace the doctor's advice and try to make healthy choices every day.

My dad and I watch the news during the short interval between our favourite shows. One day, we heard about a recession, when businesses may struggle and people have less money to spend. Dad explained how a capitalist economy works, where people can own businesses and earn profits. Another report was about a controversy between two countries, and a diplomat was trying to help them solve the problem peacefully. This led to a long discourse between Dad and me about why countries sometimes disagree. Dad tells me not to speculate before knowing all the facts. Furthermore, he says we should try to anticipate what may happen next by looking carefully at the information. Sometimes I contradict him just to hear his reasons. We also learned how some countries fought for their independence. I enjoy these talks because they help me understand the world better.
Humans have biological needs such as food, water, and sleep.
The king decided to summon his advisers for a meeting.
I try not to interfere when my friends solve a problem together.

Watering the garden with Grandpa is our morning ritual. He takes his time, and I am always reluctant to leave. He can identify every plant by its shape and smell. He knows which of his plants gives the best flavour! The insects circulate around the flowers in the warm air. A wall of tall plants protects the little nursery where new plants grow. Grandpa says a garden can stimulate a young mind. Each day, I accumulate a little more knowledge from him.

Our class had a special visit to learn about the law. A magistrate showed us around the court. A constable explained how they protect every civilian. The court hears every case fairly. Every person gets a legitimate and equal hearing, he said. The corridor had pictures of every sovereign of the past. He drew the hierarchy of the court for us. I asked who may prosecute a case, and he explained it well. The visit gave me a deep regard for the law.
Parents often sacrifice their time to care for their children.
My uncle works as an accountant for a large company in the city.
A tiny baby bird is vulnerable so its mother keeps it safe.

Our school held a science fair, and every student could join. My hypothesis was that plants grow best in warm light. I made a satisfactory model to show my idea. The judge asked me to differentiate between the two plant groups. My clear answers seemed to astonish the whole crowd. I received a certificate and a fine gift, an incentive to keep working hard. This extraordinary day showed me what hard work and intelligence can do.

This month, my history project is due, and it is my favourite of all. I enjoy mathematics and geography too, but this one is special. My project is about a famous emperor and a brave pioneer. With my teacher's permission, my dad helped me with the project after school. We reproduced an old map, drawing each dimension in centimetres. It was hard work, but so much fun. My teacher says it shows a bright and intelligent mind.
She learned how to pronounce the difficult word correctly.
The two friends reached a compromise after discussing the problem.
The office staff manage all the administrative work for the whole school.

Last week, I had a wonderful opportunity to help my community. My friends and I went to volunteer at the park near my house. We picked up all the rubbish and cleared it all away. A kind lady said we were very responsible children. I felt grateful for such a magnificent morning in the sun. Helping others is a significant part of being a good person. I will volunteer again with great enthusiasm next month!

My team played in the big tournament for football this year. We practised together every afternoon with tremendous effort. Our teacher taught us to be confident and play as one team. Every participant played with passion in the final game. The score was equal until the last minute. Suddenly, I passed the ball and my friend scored! Winning the tournament was a brilliant moment I will always remember!
The temperature drops in winter, so I wear my warm coat everyday.
It is impolite to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
Studies show that regular exercise may correlate with better health.

This year, I am a journalist for our school paper. My teacher will supervise our stories before we broadcast them to the class. This week, the highlight is the weather forecast! I plan each story with a simple framework of what happened, where, and when. We check every line to eliminate any error. We publish once a week, and that frequency feels just right. Meanwhile, my perception of news has changed, and our paper has a growing reputation. It is a privilege to entertain the whole school with our work.

We watched a wonderful episode about how birds migrate. Thousands of birds rise in a simultaneous movement, almost as one. A satellite can track their approximate path from space. Scholars study this amazing phenomenon, and each new fact is a stimulus to learn more. Sometimes, a dominant bird may take the lead while the others coordinate their movements behind it. Through evolution, some kinds of birds have even learned to swallow small insects while flying. The show explained that many birds leave when the cold days begin. Nature always fascinates me.
My whole family gathers for a big special dinner at Thanksgiving every year.
The doctor will discharge me from the hospital tomorrow morning after breakfast.
We should never discriminate against others because of their differences.

My family flew on the biggest airline to visit a foreign country. I was so enthusiastic about our first international adventure! The terminal was busy, and our departure was early in the morning. From my window seat, the landscape below looked so beautiful. The countryside had green fields and an old cathedral. My dad helped translate the local words. Travel is a wonderful teacher, and I will remember this forever!

My grandma and grandpa celebrate their anniversary every year. This year, the whole family planned a spectacular dinner together. We dressed up the room and prepared a delicious dinner. Everyone arrived with lovely gifts and warm smiles. Grandpa told wonderful stories about their trips around the world. The evening was full of laughter and joy. It was a lovely reason for the whole family to gather.
